summary: The C replay enters the Plane of Earth, but JavaScript stops at makelevel because the special-level registry has no earth loader. The actionable scope is the whole dat/earth.lua program plus its registry entry; the remaining level-description calls already have JavaScript adapters. Earth is an endgame level, so current level-generation species admission skips the main-dungeon allowlist; no Makemon change is indicated by this diagnosis.

source.branch: When a wizard uses #wizlevelport to choose Earth, the destination takes mklev.c:makelevel through the special-level branch and loads earth.lua. The program initializes the endgame map, flags, messages, terrain, arrival and portal regions, monsters, and boulder.
callers: C entry: wizcmds.c:wiz_level_tele() calls teleport.c:level_tele(); its accepted destination schedules do.c:goto_level(), which reaches mklev.c:makelevel() and the special-level branch. JavaScript: js/wizcmds.js:wiz_level_tele() calls js/teleport.js:level_tele(), then js/do.js:goto_level() reaches js/mklev.js:makelevel().

C loader: mklev.c:makelevel() calls mkmaze.c:makemaz(), which calls sp_lev.c:load_special("earth.lua") and runs the complete dat/earth.lua top-level program. JavaScript: js/mklev.js:makelevel() calls makemaz()/load_special(); ensureSpecialLevelLoaders() must register the imported js/earth_levels.js:earth() loader.

Earth Lua API calls are dispatched by sp_lev.c:lspo_level_init(), lspo_level_flags(), lspo_message(), lspo_map(), lspo_replace_terrain(), lspo_teleport_region(), lspo_levregion(), lspo_monster(), and lspo_object(); JavaScript dispatches through createSpecialLevelApi() in js/mklev.js.

The v40 manifest is 32177b16c4e84ecd535832de60e1a0758e5722ba68cb65fb5741a468a071915b; the recording is af27f4b0efd9bf8c21e05169ec8cf907bc43948eaa5c0559f918b2dbbb29a0e5; current evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-6e5dacedc7638246a629e7fe6295014ecbb0083d-v40.json is keyed to 6e5dacedc7638246a629e7fe6295014ecbb0083d.

The accepted v40 evaluation reports 23/25 screens and cursors, 2678/4897 RNG calls, and the first stop at zero-based step 23 with `unsupported level change: makelevel: load_special() has no loader for special level "earth"`.

The complete upstream program `nethack-c/upstream/dat/earth.lua` defines `des.level_init`, four level flags, three messages, the 76-by-20 map, a 5-percent rock-to-room replacement over the level, a fixed arrival tile, an air portal, the ordered monster list, and a boulder. Existing level-description dispatch covers these APIs in `js/mklev.js`.

In `js/mklev.js`, `makelevel()` throws the observed refusal at line 705 when `SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS` has no base loader; `ensureSpecialLevelLoaders()` imports the Fire, Air, and Water modules but registers no Earth module. The source-backed fix is the whole Earth Lua program in `js/earth_levels.js`, generated map data from the upstream map literal, and one registry entry under `contract:special-level-loader-registry`.

The Earth level is in the Endgame. `js/makemon_create.js:preflightCreation()` applies its explicit species allowlist only outside level creation or for main-dungeon level generation; the Earth generation path is `in_mklev` on a non-main dungeon. The existing Makemon path is therefore not an identified prerequisite for this loader task; the admitted differential will verify its descriptors.
